snippet.title: Sin & Siege — announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Join the playtest on Steam — https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834300/Sin__Siege/

Sin & Siege is a strategy game with rogue-lite elements in which you must restore several circles of hell. Capture and recycle sinful souls, accumulate sins, create new demons, populate hell, and defend it from holy monsters.
